card.line: Dothan is a city north of Samaria where Joseph found his brothers, and where God protected the prophet Elisha from an enemy army.

moments.title: Joseph finds his brothers
moments.text: Joseph goes looking for his brothers and finds them at Dothan. They plot to kill him, but Reuben speaks up to save his life, and they strip Joseph of his robe of many colors.

moments.title: The king hunts Elisha
moments.text: The king of Aram learns that Elisha is in Dothan. He sends horses, chariots, and a great army by night to surround the city.

moments.title: Fiery chariots on the hills
moments.text: Elisha's servant is afraid when he sees the army. Elisha prays, and the LORD opens the young man's eyes to see the hills full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.

moments.title: The army struck blind
moments.text: Elisha prays, and the LORD strikes the Arameans with blindness. Elisha then tells them to follow him and leads them to Samaria.
